BrochureContent.Content:
Magnificent spacious, four bedroom family home in a large mature private garden. Along with the stunning views over the beautiful garden, there are panoramic views of the renowned Blackwater Valley.
This one-off Architect designed house is a unique opportunity to obtain a stunning family home in it’s own mature gardens in a quiet area close to Mallow Town. 
The property enjoys an enviable location for the golfing enthusiast adjoining Mallow Golf Club.
The superb mature garden is a delight from every angle, in every season and can be enjoyed fully from every window of the house. There is also c.¼ acre of private woodland with this property.
The property is entered through an enchanting, yellow feature door, into a spacious light flood filled hallway. Leading from this are a bright breakfast/ dining room and the warm kitchen with solid wood maple, shaker style kitchen, a hatch to the formal dining room and integrated hob and double cooker. The kitchen enjoys beautiful views of the garden and surrounding countryside. Also off the kitchen is the large morning sun filled family living room with East facing French doors leading to the side lawn and shrubbery. This room enjoys the efficient warmth of a wood burning stove.
Also off the kitchen is the Utility room, back hall with back door, store room and guest WC.
The spacious, light filled main Sitting room with formal dining room has panoramic views of the garden and the renowned Blackwater Valley. The feature wall has an inviting open fireplace. 
The patio and garden areas can be accessed through double glass sliding doors making it a superb house for BBQ’s and get togethers with family and friends.

The light filled upstairs has 4 bedrooms with views of different aspects of the garden and panoramic views to the back. The large spacious master bedroom enjoys the extra comfort of and ensuite, dressing room and a large fitted wardrobe.
The bright family bathroom has both a shower and a bath.
The property is in excellent condition and must be viewed to be appreciated.

This property consists of entrance hall, sittingroom, livingroom, kitchen, diningroom, utility room, guest wc and store room on the ground floor. Upstairs comprises of four bedrooms – one en suite with walk in wardrobe and bathroom

Highlights
•	Beautifully c.2000sq ft four-bedroom detached residence
•	Panoramic views across the stunning Blackwater Valley to the mountains.
•	Enchanting mature colourful gardens
•	Site in excess of c.1 acre
•	C.¼ acres of private woodland
•	Ideal family home
•	Directly adjoining 2nd green and 3rd tee of Mallow golf club. 
•	Large patio to side and rear
•	Spacious, light filled Sitting room with panoramic garden windows, double glass doors to patio areas and garden areas.
•	Cosy family living room with double doors to lawns and shrubbery on the East side.
•	Oil Fired Central Heating/Modern condensing boiler
•	Alarm and CCTV
•	Tarmacadam driveway, entrance wall & piers with ample parking
•	Situated in a safe, quiet, mature suburb of Mallow.
•	Walking distance from Mallow town, shops, schools, recreation facilities, trains and busses.
•	Easy access to Cork/ Limerick Road (N20)
